'''dominyx Errata Killed My Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[dominyx]]
* '''Published:''' 24 November 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Holotable|ANH-D-imperialholotable.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Imperial Holotable
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor Imperial Holotable dominyx DS 2003 ErrataKi.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Well, it was fun while I didn't look at the errata sheet at least...
